decision_note: READY requires complete provider/trajectory gates, at least two workload kinds, at least ten complete pairs, and either a positive reward confidence lower bound or quality non-regression plus a confidence-bounded versioned/billed cost reduction or provider-call reduction. It also requires a healthy canary decision bound to the expected frozen health policy and the same executable rollback bundle; this offline report supplies no operational canary evidence by itself. Absolute token or wall-time growth is descriptive, not an automatic regression: quality still comes from the independent verifier, while typed progress/recovery evidence explains whether longer execution was productive.
